Dr. Lauren Baker is a Pediatric Physical Therapist in Boise, Idaho with a Doctorate and Manual Therapy Certification from the University of St. Augustine for Health Sciences and a BS in Athletic Training from the University of Iowa.  

She has built a thriving career while navigating the unique challenges as a military spouse, including serving as an adjunct professor in the DPT curriculum, owning multiple successful cash based mobile pediatric physical therapy practices, and authoring six books on baby development and pediatric physical therapy for both parents and healthcare providers. She now focuses on empowering proactive parents through her books, blog, and her YouTube channel. Follow along on her travels and get behind the scenes content - https://www.instagram.com/drlaurenbaker

Order the newest learning to crawl book here: https://drlaurenbaker.com/learning-to-crawl-book

Audio podcast uploads are varied & comments are responded to monthly. Video uploads coming back 2028.
